subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a measurement of seasonal variation?
solution:
The correct answer is** Graphic method.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Graphic method:**

 
 
• The graphic method involves plotting data on a graph to visually identify patterns and trends over time.
 
• While this method can be useful for visual analysis, it does not provide a precise measurement of seasonal variation.
 
• It is more qualitative in nature and does not involve the quantitative techniques used in other methods.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ratio-to-trend method:**

 
 
• This method involves calculating the ratio of actual values to the trend values to measure seasonal variation.
 
• It helps in identifying how much the actual data deviates from the trend due to seasonal factors.
 
 
 
• **Simple averages:**
 
 
• This method calculates the average of data for each season to measure seasonal variation.
 
• It is a straightforward approach that helps in understanding the typical seasonal pattern.
 
 
 
• **Ratio-to-moving-average method:**
 
 
• This method involves dividing the actual data by the moving average to eliminate trend effects and isolate seasonal variations.
 
• It is a common quantitative technique used to measure seasonal fluctuations.
